title: Why 0% Interest Plans Cost You More
hook_text: ZERO PERCENT INTEREST IS A TRAP

beats.say: Split it into four easy payments. That phrase tricks your brain every single time.
beats.visual: A sleek smartphone resting on a dark walnut table, screen glowing with a soft neutral light in a dim room.

beats.say: It feels harmless because the price tag looks small. But here is the exact math they hide.
beats.visual: A pair of hands sliding a minimalist leather wallet across a concrete surface.

beats.say: When debt sits at 24% APR, debt doubles every 3 years. That is the rule of 72.
beats.visual: A vintage mechanical calculator resting on a messy desk under an amber desk lamp.

beats.say: Now add missed deadlines. A single late fee turns that free plan into an expensive mistake.
beats.visual: A close-up of a silver wristwatch ticking in slow motion against a dark background.

beats.say: Retailers offer zero percent because shoppers spend up to 40% more with it.
beats.visual: Empty wooden shopping hangers swaying gently on a steel clothing rack.

beats.say: You do not buy the item. You buy the illusion of affordability.
beats.visual: A brass key resting on top of a stack of closed cardboard delivery boxes.

beats.say: Small payments stack up until you are juggling four different payment apps at once.
beats.visual: A steaming ceramic mug of black coffee sitting on a wooden counter with morning light.

beats.say: That is how a fifty dollar purchase quietly morphs into a cash flow emergency.
beats.visual: A blurred stack of crisp paper notes held by a rubber band on a slate table.

beats.say: If you cannot pay cash today, you cannot afford the payment tomorrow.
beats.visual: A minimalist metal lamp casting harsh shadows across a bare white wall.

beats.say: Break the habit before the tiny bills break your monthly budget completely.
beats.visual: A pair of hands closing a black leather journal with a sharp click.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, because split into four easy...
beats.visual: A silhouette of a person walking down a quiet hallway toward an open doorway.

caption: Split payments feel free until the fees hit. Know the math. #money #personalfinance #budgeting #debtfree
description: Buy-now-pay-later plans seem harmless with zero interest, but the psychology of small payments leads to massive overspending and hidden fees.
first_comment: Have you ever used a buy-now-pay-later plan? Did you finish it on time?
